hero_kpi_rationale: Key profitability indicator for banks, reflecting effective management of the spread between lending rates and deposit rates

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between loan rates and deposit rates, in %
kpis.description: The net interest margin is a key indicator of a bank's profitability
kpis.signal: Stability of the net interest margin

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.description: Return on equity measures the profitability generated from shareholders' equity

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Core capital ratio (shares + reserves) divided by risk-weighted assets
kpis.description: The common equity tier 1 ratio measures the strength and resilience of a bank's capital against risks
kpis.signal: Stability of the common equity tier 1 ratio

kpis.name: Loan Book Balance
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans granted and not yet repaid
kpis.description: The loan book balance reflects growth in the loan portfolio and expansion of the bank's business volume
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in loan book balance
